title: 第17章 请神术第18章 巅峰赛选手登场
content_zh:
吃完早饭的四目道长回到了卧室里，在陈旧的书架和堆满杂物的箱子里，翻箱倒柜地寻找了起来。
几分钟后，手里拿着一本古朴册子的四目道长走了出来。
看到正在和嘉乐聊天的林道然，就笑着将手中的册子扔了过去。
“道然，师叔跟你师父讨论过，你现在降妖除魔的手段看起来虽然是挺多的。有银符境的符箓、铜体境的炼体还有大成的金光咒和闪电奔雷拳，这些手段虽然都很强大，但还是不够！你还缺少了些保命的手段！否则一旦遭遇强敌，你将无计可施！甚至连跑都跑不了！”
“这本册子里记载的是师叔的绝技——茅山请神术！一经施展，便能请得祖师爷出手相助！一旦修炼至大成圆满，还能请得天上的正神出手！你可以将此当作保命手段修炼一番！遭遇危险不能力敌时，请祖师爷出手。按照祖师爷对你的宠爱程度，怕是飞僵旱魃之类的敌人都会被灭成齑粉！”
“道然谢过师叔的教导！”
林道然接过册子，满脸感动道。
“好啦！别做那种动不动就满脸泪光的小女子姿态了！师叔可是期待着你成为这末法时代的天师的！到时候，师叔就可以每天在老和尚面前炫耀了！所以只要是你需要，师叔有的！师叔都可以给你！你要做的就是好好修炼！”
四目道长摆摆手，大度地说道。
毕竟对于自家这个从小看大的师侄，四目道长别说有多喜欢了！自家师侄从小就听话懂事，修炼天赋好还勤奋，对长辈尊师重道，对师弟关爱有加！以至于四目道长经常在九叔面前抱怨，为啥林道然不是他的徒弟！
……
深夜
经过四目道长一天的教导，林道然已经成功入门了请神术，甚至已经达到了小成境界了。
从打坐中醒来的林道然伸了伸懒腰，正准备躺下睡觉。
咚咚咚！咚咚咚！！
彷佛带着功德+1+1+1+1+1字样的木鱼声从一休大师那边传来。
听着这略显刺耳的木鱼声，林道然莫名想起了自己前世的那个电子木鱼！
回过神，无奈地摇了摇头，然后从空间里掏出了一张静声符，施展法力往地上一贴，只见一个直径5米的透明圆圈悄然出现，将林道然罩住，木鱼声戛然而止。
感觉周遭一片寂静的林道然满意地点了点头，扯上被褥，往床上一躺，两眼一闭，没一会儿，均匀而又绵长的呼吸声便在罩子里响起。
这边林道然是舒服了，可是另一边正在睡觉的四目道长不干了。

好不容易赶尸回来，都好几天没好好休息了，昨晚还一晚上没睡，正要睡他个天昏地暗，好好把精神养足。
你就给我大半夜地敲起了木鱼，念起了经！老和尚，你是专门来跟我作对的吗？
来到窗边，看着对面房间里正襟危坐，双目紧闭的一休，一手拿着木槌，一下一下地敲击着木鱼；一手拿着念珠，随着口中念动的佛经，慢慢转动着。
看着一休那明显沉入心神，忘我的念经状态。四目道长只能骂骂咧咧地回到了床边，拿出自己珍藏的各种道具，一样一样试了起来。
椰子壳！没用！
棉花！没用！
灯芯耳塞！没用！
……
在四目道长即将疯狂的时候，一休大师停止了敲木鱼念经，睡觉了！
听着耳边的木鱼声消失，四目道长欣喜无比，立马跟随着一休大师的步伐，躺下睡觉。
随着桌子上的蜡烛燃尽，留下一滩凝固的烛泪和一截短短的烛芯，院子里也传来了大公鸡的坤坤声。
咚咚咚！咚咚咚！
已经睡醒的一休大师，又开始了早上的功课，敲木鱼念经。
“啊！受不了了！老和尚！”
四目道长的卧室里传来了一阵怒骂声。
四目依次从耳朵上取下了椰子壳、瓷碗、棉花、灯芯等东西。从床底拉出了个箱子，扛着便出了门。
“师父，你这么早去一休大师那里干吗？”
叠好被子，正准备去做饭的嘉乐，看着师父抱着一个箱子往一休大师那边走去，不解地问道。
content_en:
After breakfast, Taoist priest Shimu returned to the bedroom and rummaged through the old bookshelves and boxes filled with miscellaneous items.
A few minutes later, the four-eyed Taoist priest came out with a simple book in his hand.
Seeing Lin Daoran chatting with Jia Le, he smiled and threw the booklet in his hand over.
"Daoran, my uncle has discussed with your master. It seems that you have quite a lot of means to subjugate and eliminate demons now. There are talismans in the silver talisman realm, body refining in the bronze body realm, and Dacheng's golden light spell and lightning running thunder fist. Although these methods are very powerful, they are still not enough! You still lack some life-saving means! Otherwise, once you encounter a strong enemy, you will be unable to do anything! You can't even run!"
"What is recorded in this booklet is Uncle Master's unique skill - the Maoshan Invitation Technique! Once it is used, you can ask the Grandmaster to help! Once you practice to perfection, you can also ask the God of Heaven to help! You can practice this as a way to save your life! When you are in danger and unable to defeat the enemy, ask the Grandmaster to take action. According to the extent of the Grandmaster's love for you, I am afraid that enemies such as Fei Zonghanban will be destroyed to pieces!"
"Daoran thanks my uncle for his teaching!"
Lin Daoran took the booklet and said with emotion on his face.
"Okay! Don't act like a little girl who always bursts into tears! Uncle Master is looking forward to you becoming a heavenly master in this era of Dharma Ending! By then, Uncle Master will be able to show off in front of the old monk every day! So as long as you need it, Uncle Master has it! Uncle Master can give it to you! All you have to do is practice hard!"
Taoist Priest Four Eyes waved his hand and said magnanimously.
After all, Taoist Priest Four Eyes couldn't say more about how much he liked his nephew, whom he had grown up with! My nephew has been obedient and sensible since he was a child. He is talented in cultivation and diligent. He respects his elders and cares for his juniors! So much so that Taoist Priest Four Eyes often complained in front of Uncle Jiu, why Lin Daoran was not his disciple!
…
late at night
After a day's instruction from Taoist Master Four Eyes, Lin Daoran has successfully learned the art of inviting gods, and has even reached the level of Xiaocheng.
Lin Daoran, who woke up from meditation, stretched and was about to lie down and sleep.
Boom, boom, boom! Boom, boom, boom! !
The sound of a wooden fish with the words "merit +1+1+1+1+1" came from Master Ikkyu.
Listening to the slightly harsh sound of the wooden fish, Lin Daoran inexplicably remembered the electronic wooden fish in his previous life!
After coming back to his senses, he shook his head helplessly, then took out a Silence Talisman from the space, used his magic power to place it on the ground, and saw a transparent circle with a diameter of 5 meters quietly appeared, covering Lin Daoran, and the sound of the wooden fish stopped abruptly.
Feeling the silence around him, Lin Daoran nodded with satisfaction, pulled up the quilt, lay down on the bed, and closed his eyes. After a while, even and long breathing sounded from the cover.
Lin Daoran felt comfortable here, but Taoist priest Simu who was sleeping on the other side stopped.
After finally returning from the corpse drive, I haven't had a good rest for several days. I didn't sleep all night last night and was about to sleep until I was in a state of darkness to recuperate my energy.
You just knocked on wooden fish and recited sutras for me in the middle of the night! Old monk, are you here specifically to oppose me?
When I came to the window, I looked at Yixiu who was sitting upright in the opposite room with his eyes closed. He was holding a mallet in one hand and hitting the wooden fish time and time again. He was holding a rosary in the other hand and slowly turning it in accordance with the Buddhist sutras he was chanting in his mouth.
Looking at Ikkyu, he was obviously deep in his mind and in a selfless state of chanting sutras. Taoist Priest Four Eyes could only curse and return to the bedside, took out the various props he had collected, and tried them all.
Coconut shell! Useless!
cotton! Useless!
Wick earplugs! Useless!
…
When Taoist Master Shimu was about to go crazy, Master Yixiu stopped knocking on the wooden fish and chanting sutras and went to sleep!
Hearing the sound of wooden fish disappear in his ears, Daoist Master Shimu was extremely happy. He immediately followed Master Ikkyu's steps and lay down to sleep.
FollowAs the candle on the table burned out, leaving behind a pool of solidified candle tears and a short wick, the sound of a big rooster came from the yard.
Boom, boom, boom! Boom, boom, boom!
Master Ikkyu, who had already woken up, started his morning homework again, knocking on wooden fish and chanting sutras.
"Ah! I can't stand it anymore! Old monk!"
A burst of angry curses came from the bedroom of Taoist Priest Simu.
Simu took out coconut shells, porcelain bowls, cotton, wicks and other things from his ears in turn. He pulled a box out from under the bed and carried it out the door.
"Master, why are you going to Master Ikkyu so early?"
Jiale, who had folded the quilt and was about to cook, watched his master carrying a box towards Master Ikkyu and asked in confusion.
